title: Merge Paginated Results
statement: Read n, then n lines each a JSON array of integers (pages of results). Print the total count of items across all pages combined.
starter_code:
n = int(input())
import json
total = 0
for _ in range(n):
    page = json.loads(input())
    total += len(page)
print(total)
hints: This one's fully written already - study how each page is parsed and its length added to the running total
